issue_context.title: [Feature]: pick snapshot in UI Mode
issue_context.body:
### 🚀 Feature Request

pick aria snapshot in ui mode

### Example

when converting tests from toHaveText to use aria snapshots the it would be great to be able to run the test in UI Mode and then click the pick locator icon and choose aria snapshot for that part of the page.

### Motivation

recording a test each time you want to just get the snapshot is a frustrating and long process.
